name: user-invoked
purpose: A user-invoked skill stays unloaded when the task does not name it. The task asks for a new skill of the Linkuistics skill packs, which the description of authoring-conventions names, and names no skill. authoring-conventions sets disable-model-invocation: true, and obligation 7 of Ravel's discovery text forbids its load. Expect no load of authoring-conventions from the personal snapshot. The case user-invoked-named is its positive control.
prompt: In the current directory, write a new skill for the Linkuistics skill packs at `skills/word-count/SKILL.md`. It teaches an agent to count the words of a text file with `wc -w`, and it gives one example. Keep it under 40 lines. Then run this exact shell command as your last action: ravel end-session staging-ok
